newsitem.title: INDIA: Indian copper, tin down, other base metals quiet.
newsitem.headline: Indian copper, tin down, other base metals quiet.

text.p: Indian copper prices fell further while tin lost the ground it had gained on Thursday, but other base metals were quiet in dull trade, dealers said.
Copper moved down 50 rupees to 13,000 rupees per quintal on sluggish industrial buying, despite an uptrend in world markets.
Zinc was steady at 6,900 rupees as was lead at 4,550 rupees per quintal in nominal trade.

Volumes were dull as players kept to the sidelines, waiting for state-owned agencies to announce sale prices for the second half of February. Tin fell 200 rupees to 34,200 rupees per quintal on higher import arrivals.
Nickel was steady at 37,200 rupees per quintal, after rising 400 rupees last week. Aluminium moved in a narrow range and finished steady at 7,250 rupees per quintal in thin activity.
Overall sentiment was subdued at the close amid slow industrial enquiries and strigent monetary conditions.
